rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a topic being talked about, especially in conversation.

example.english: This topic is really sensitive, so don’t bring it up at dinner.
example.traditional: 呢個話題真係幾敏感，唔好喺飯局度講。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 waa6 tai4 zan1 hai6 gei2 man5 gam2 m4 hou2 hai2 faan6 guk6 dou6 gong2

rows.note: Use this for the theme or general subject of a work, event, course, or area of interest, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: The topic of this course is artificial intelligence.
example.traditional: 今期課程嘅主題係人工智能。
example.jyutping: gam1 kei4 fo3 cing4 ge3 zyu2 tai4 hai6 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an online discussion thread containing an initial post and replies.

example.english: This discussion thread on the topic of artificial intelligence already has hundreds of replies.
example.traditional: 呢條關於人工智能嘅討論串已經有幾百個回覆。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gwaan1 jyu1 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 ge3 tou2 leon6 cyun3 ji5 ging1 jau5 gei2 baak3 go3 wui4 fuk1
